title: Smith's memo to the PSB on 1,500 UFO reports

tellings.quote: Another document, this time from Smith to the director of the Psychological Strategy Board, notes that over 1,500 UFO reports had been logged.

plain: In 1952, the CIA director Walter B. Smith sent a memo to the head of the Psychological Strategy Board, a Cold War body that planned propaganda and psychological operations, noting that over 1,500 UFO reports had been logged. Michels describes the memo himself on an episode about Henry Kissinger, as one document among others. He raises it to show that the CIA was counting UFO sightings and sharing them with officials who handled public perception.
